text:
Type: pink floral wreath rug
Use: soft floor cover beside a bed or play area; kids room, nursery, bedroom
Style: retro, traditional
Materials: soft low pile with a printed pattern
Colors: soft pink, dusty rose, small dark dots, brown bands
Shape: rectangle with an oval floral wreath in the center, scattered polka dots, thin brown bands at both ends, flat
Feel: sweet, romantic, soft
Goes with: white furniture, pastel textiles, light wood; children's rooms, nurseries, romantic or shabby-chic bedrooms

product.name: RARING
product.description: This rug is both soft and decorative and creates a personal, cosy atmosphere in your childs room.
